goal: Generate and verify a real postgraduate-exam assistant whose independent typed business features are built as parallel leaves and integrated through one thin JSON CLI without persistence, networking, frameworks, GUI, or unrelated architecture.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh reviewed Qwen run records leaf batches, repair scope, semantic-review metrics, and zero undeclared architecture.
At least two independent feature leaves share no owned paths and are scheduled in the same dependency-ready parallel batch.
One thin JSON CLI adapter depends on the independent feature leaves without redefining their business logic.
The generated project contains only standard-library source, one JSON CLI adapter, focused pytest tests, packaging metadata, and requested documentation.
The goal freezes at least three explicit business feature contracts with exact typed inputs, outputs, errors, side effects, dependencies, owned paths, and acceptance checks.
The supported generated-project test profile passes while formal delivery remains separately evaluated.

quality_metrics.target: all management, iteration, and experience artifacts validate
quality_metrics.method: jsonschema tests plus deterministic manager validation

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path

quality_metrics.measure: short-request planning fidelity and safe feature concurrency
quality_metrics.target: one explicit operation yields one public feature, zero invented persistence or generic workflows, frozen input/output/error/side-effect/file-ownership interfaces, and deterministic conflict-free parallel batches
quality_metrics.method: requirement-decision contract tests, feature-DAG scheduling tests, Provider leaf-context tests, negative scope-expansion fixtures, and a fresh reviewed Qwen acceptance run

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: allocate_subject_hours(subject_weights_json: str, weekly_hours: float) -> str parses a JSON object of positive subject weights and returns a JSON object whose nonnegative hours sum to weekly_hours.
rank_review_topics(topics_json: str) -> str parses topic records and returns deterministic highest-priority-first JSON without mutating input.
build_revision_calendar(start_date: str, exam_date: str, daily_hours: float) -> str returns deterministic foundation, intensive, and sprint phase dates and hours.
The package CLI accepts exactly one JSON request naming one operation and payload, then prints exactly one JSON result object.
All three business leaves have no side effects, no feature dependencies, distinct owned paths, and one shared dependency-ready batch.
